description: This Java source file defines the class BinaryRequestProxyingHandler, which handles proxying of binary requests over Netty channels, including logging, request forwarding, and response handling.

classes.name: BinaryRequestProxyingHandler
classes.description: A Netty channel handler that proxies binary requests, manages request/response flow, and logs events.

methods.name: channelRead0
methods.description: Handles incoming ByteBuf messages, interprets them as binary requests, and forwards or rejects them based on protocol.

methods.name: sendMessage

methods.description: Processes the binary response asynchronously without waiting for the response before proceeding.

methods.name: processWaitingForResponse
methods.description: Processes the binary response synchronously, waiting for the response before proceeding.
